name: mirage
text: v1.0.63 is released: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.63 With it: (1) Off, Recommend and Automatic now control the GitHub engine. Off posts nothing. Recommend: the engine lists the bids it would place and posts one only when you press Post. Automatic: the engine posts by itself. (2) The new 'Restart bid engine' button clears the picked-off stop so bids resume at once; it also appears on the red stopped banner. (3) Cancel and Cancel all on the tab act on the engine's bids. (4) Bid rule and slider edits are held until 15 seconds after your last change, then sent to GitHub together, and the engine re-runs its bids on them at once. A mode switch (Off, Recommend, Automatic) or any other setting is sent immediately, so Off is never delayed. (5) The tab shows the engine's real resting bids, fills and stop reason. I've started a fresh engine runner so it picks up the new code. I haven't watched a live Recommend, Post or Restart yet, so try them and tell me what you see.
